notes: The 📐 Technical button now explains itself. Pressing it ranks every loaded share by classic chart signals (golden cross, near 52-week high, above the 200-day average, oversold RSI, rising money-flow, gap up) and shows them in the main table, strongest first — that part is unchanged.
